excerpt.zh:
我们的创世方舟在召集了所有当地的未开智物种后，开始为它们建立一个创世保护区。

[THIS.GetName]上的殖民地已经准备好观测、以及对这一新兴物种的发展进行引导。
excerpt.en:
After gathering the native pre-sapient species, our Genesis Ark began creating a Genesis Preserve for them.

The colony of [THIS.GetName] is ready to observe and guide this nascent species' development.
